model.name: merge.currentBranchApi
model.description: The server resolves the current checked-out branch (git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) and serves it via GET /api/git/current-branch, so the center header (setCenterTitle) can show filename@currentBranch. Server side of R30.38 centerHeaderBranch; sibling of merge.centerHeaderBranch (abad9982=client render). Minted 2026-07-19 to keep the built server method chain-reachable under the locked one-UC-one-method walker (not orphaned).
